positive_snippets: The hotel is affordable and better than a Three star hotel. It has all the facilities, there is no restriction except u cannot bring outside food, they have fast internet as well as per your needs. Hot water provision. They have diner as well you can order upto 12 pm, overall it's a nice place to stay for 3-4 days affordable as well and staff is well behaved. If you pay them nice theyll clean your car as well. Good parking space. Go for it I would say.....

negative_snippets: My stay at this hotel last night was profoundly disappointing and utterly unacceptable. The room cleanliness was appalling; the carpets were visibly stained, and surfaces were dusty, showing a clear failure in housekeeping standards. The washroom was particularly shocking, with dirty toilet seat, making it feel unsanitary and unusable. To make matters worse, when I attempted to report these serious issues to the staff, I was met with a total lack of concern, demonstrating a severe lack of professionalism and basic customer service. Due to the shocking lack of hygiene and the unprofessional behavior of the team, I would strongly caution anyone against staying here.
